description: This PHP source file defines the PDFConfigurator class within the SuiteCRM\'PDF\' namespace. The class facilitates configuration of PDF generation settings for SuiteCRM, including setting the PDF engine and saving configurations. It also utilizes a Configurator class to handle underlying configuration logic.

classes.name: PDFConfigurator
classes.description: A class to manage PDF configuration settings in SuiteCRM, allowing creation, modification, and saving of PDF engine preferences.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configurator, optionally accepting an existing Configurator object.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new PDFConfigurator for fluent syntax.

methods.name: setEngine
methods.description: Sets the default PDF engine for the configuration after validating that the engine string is not empty.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current configuration using the underlying Configurator's saveConfig method.
